question.problem:
Consider a function $\mathbf{f}: \mathbb R^{2\times 3} \to \mathbb R^2$ defined by
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14217875/assets/7583605f8c8c3cd07389b8f31c6bfc4eaaf3a6488f226a05d5e0972e5272c2c8.svg)
Given that $a_{ij}$ denotes the entry of $\mathbf{A}$ in the intersection of the $i$th row and $j$th column, find the value of $\dfrac{\partial f_1}{\partial a_{12}}.$
question.worked_solution:
We can write the function $\mathbf{f}$ as
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14217875/assets/ed6fb0575a19c9afb201170a089841d0271e20e219c54c956e03f5d3e8c87f41.svg)

Thus,

$$
\dfrac{\partial f_1}{\partial a_{12}} = \dfrac{\partial}{\partial a_{12}} (-a_{11} + 3a_{12} + 7a_{13} ) = 3.
$$
